entities.name: Stangg
entities.description: Human warrior of Dominaria, bald with a red-haired beard and heavy armor, who may have had a twin; known in southwestern Jamuraa in 3335 AR.

entities.name: War with Phyrexia
entities.description: Conflict at the time of which Stangg lived.

events.summary: Stangg's name is invoked in the idiom "Stangg’s Stones!" by 4077 AR.
